en: A black‑and‑white vintage street view of a small town with wooden houses lining a dirt road that rises uphill through trees. In the foreground three children stand barefoot in the middle of the unpaved street. On the left corner is a wooden building with signage reading "JOH. WALTON…". At the top left of the image is printed the caption "Jyväskylä", indicating the town. Utility poles and simple early‑20th‑century architecture suggest an old Northern European setting.
